report.title: on-box smoke images are never removed after the workload
report.evidence: Current code removes each target only before pulling (lines 217-228), pulls into /root/images subdirectories (lines 271-273), then replaces the process with `exec sh scripts/run-smoke.sh "$@"` at line 418. `run-smoke.sh` contains no image-directory cleanup, while docs/misc/local-smoke-debian.md:170-171 promises deletion when the workload exits.
report.suggested_fix: Install an EXIT cleanup trap before pulling, invoke run-smoke.sh without exec while preserving its status, and remove both image directories on success, failure, or interruption.

report.title: the derived Python matrix cannot run a non-3.11 leg
report.evidence: Executed `uv sync --locked --group dev --python 3.12`; it exited 2 with `Using CPython 3.12.14` and `incompatible with the project's Python requirement: ==3.11.*`. test.yml:131-136 passes every derived matrix version to this command, and the matrix reader's own fixture explicitly derives both 3.11 and 3.12 from py311/py312.
report.suggested_fix: Make requires-python and uv.lock cover every supported matrix minor while retaining .python-version as the local default; add a guard that exercises all derived Python versions.
